Definition: from G48; a cleansing (the act), i.e. (ceremonially) lustration:--purification.
BiblicalUsage: hagnismós is the word for purification. In Acts 21:26, the text says "to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hagnismós, I take at face value: purification.
RelatedEvents: Paul Purifies Himself at the Temple
